title: ozothamnus rodwayi
intro: Ozothamnus rodwayi, commonly known as Rodway's everlasting, is a flowering plant species native to the island of Tasmania. It belongs to the family Asteraceae and is known for its medicinal properties. Rodway's everlasting has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its health benefits.
